LampForm Lab v0.4 / gradient
Units: mm. Flat pieces; lattice 1 mm, rim 4 mm.
HAB-2 -> Mold; Sub-Merged -> Push. Tools are unchanged.
Open both STL in a slicer and inspect layers before printing.
Relative geometric/structural demand, NOT calibrated polymer strain.
Parameters, convergence and mesh checks are in the accompanying JSON files.
Candidate geometry reloaded and checked closed, single body, with no duplicate or degenerate faces.
